concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-apple-pay-ios-drop-in]] — 2023-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Apple Pay iOS Drop-in Sessions/Advanced guide for own-certificate setup, versioned native configuration, recurring tokenization handoff and TEST/LIVE limits; code examples require version-aware review.
warnings: The v5.3+ table lists merchantIdentifier but its shown initializer passes only paymentRequest; the v4 example builds a payment value but does not pass it in the shown configuration call (raw lines 56–129).
Apple Pay setup and PKRecurringPaymentRequest do not establish consent capture, token creation, successful authorization, capture or settlement.
